instructions: When someone asked about Transactions only show them at a monthly level even if they ask for daily .Please do not add daily or weekly tokens into search and use Weekly instead.
Weeks Ago, Months Ago, and Years Ago should only ever be filters and never measures or attributes

When doing metric time comparisons always use the ago columns. For example if a user ask show me sales for the last 4 weeks compared to the prior 4 weeks, you should compare weeks ago <=5 to weeks 6-9. If the question is comparing to the prior year, find the range that is on a 52 weeks behind. For example the last 4 weeks compared to the same time last year would compare weeks 0-5 to weeks 54-57.
If the ask is months ago it should follow the same pattern as week but be on a 12 value lag instead of a 52 value lag like weeks.
Also show the difference in verancne and percentage when comparing to a prior period.
